[[Jedeh's Artifact]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Jedeh the Mighty]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Crystal Overlook]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Communing]])
:[[Communing]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skills]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Eerie Focus (ouroboros)]].

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Communing Focus]] from collector [[Elder Ezio]] or crafter [[Sheco]].


Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[Communing]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Communing Focus]] from collector [[Jwup]]
**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Focus]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Focus]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*One of the following [[Channeling Magic]] [[focus item]]s:
**[[Communing Focus]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Spirit Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Focus of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Focus]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Focus]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Focus]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Focus]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Focus]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Focus]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Master of My Domain]]" inscription

[[Quansong's Focus]] has stats identical to this item.
